splitPolicy: Same paper group across titles and abstracts; cached/exposed external benchmarks train-only. Test sources reserved before annotation.
normalization: none: source abstract Unicode text retained exactly
promotion: No automatic promotion; require rare-class support and independent evaluation. No closed title test tuning.
relationScope: Only explicitly supported METHOD->TASK or METHOD->DATASET; unresolved coreference is not a negative.

iterationCompact.goal: Add real abstract evidence for missing DATASET/EVALUATED_ON support
iterationCompact.successMetric: usable source-matched abstracts and explicit rare labels, not inflated F1
iterationCompact.mistakeBudget: zero fabricated abstracts, source joins, copied title labels or cross-split paper groups
iterationCompact.baseline: Title production unchanged; preceding dev constrained decoder rejected
iterationCompact.nextExperiment: Source availability, then AI-labelled pilot and strict token/offset preflight
iterationCompact.fallback: Keep old model and graph; preserve failed acquisition without synthetic substitute
